name: Secret Night
source: A quiet, normal day, but suddenly you get a call from your daughter. She opens up about her feelings for you. It will be up to you to accept to take the relationship between a father and a daughter to something more. No matter what happens, but what you are sure of is that it will have to be a Secret Night.​
